acceptance_criteria.criterion: Core tetap opsional: tanpa amr_sentry/SDK/PyYAML, core tidak import/init/capture SDK dan hook no-op tetap usable.
Konfigurasi satu file YAML/YML/JSON: path default/override, mapping/policy/defaults tepat; invalid non-fatal dan tidak fallback ke env/Settings.
Delta validasi safe-profile file-only: setiap safety key wajib bertipe/nilai exact; missing/unsafe/unknown ditolak sebelum SDK init; kwargs efektif identik file, tanpa injected privacy kwargs.
Mode all/error/selected/none dan enabled/DSN sesuai matriks; selected memerlukan record opt-in, precedence client eksplisit dipertahankan; tanpa kwargs fallback/tags lama.
Dengan real SDK, nol event di luar hook dari logging/unhandled exceptions; integrations efektif kosong; nol automatic telemetry yang tak diminta.

Payload telemetry tidak memuat private args/body/header/credential/customer markers, locals/vars, source context atau ambient metadata; diagnostic telemetry generik; exception-text dinilai terpisah D-EX.
Hasil bisnis call/dispatch/log/action dipertahankan; failure SDK init/capture/transport best-effort; bukan masking business failure atau memperbaiki defect baseline diam-diam.
Tidak double report satu outcome; request-success lalu handler-error adalah dua outcome, bukan satu duplikat.
Load/init sekali per proses, restart reload; file/Settings/env dan SDK global/current/isolation scope tidak mencemari policy atau lintas DB/worker; D-GLOBAL wajib diselesaikan.
Target tepat Odoo 13/CPython 3.7.3; core-only, optional fresh install dan upgrade diuji dengan full inventory/constraints test-only disetujui; pin produksi tidak diubah implisit.
README/operator konsisten, contoh aman lengkap, per-client UI opt-in ada, global UI lama tidak efektif; root requirement dan optional packaging dijelaskan tanpa klaim produksi.
Semua evidence terikat candidate/spec/config/environment, oracle per-case, no-egress dan cleanup per-resource termasuk volume IDs; tidak mewarisi PASS/waiver historis.

cases.title: Core-only tanpa optional dependencies
cases.preconditions: Sandbox core-only bersih; graph prerequisite core lengkap, tanpa sentry_sdk/yaml.
cases.steps: Fresh install amr_service_client; baca registry; lakukan success/error hook dan smoke core.
cases.expected: Core installed/usable, SDK tidak terimport/init/capture; prerequisite core yang hilang = BLOCKED, bukan telemetry FAIL.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Path dan parser
cases.preconditions: Fixture file read-only YAML/YML/JSON ekuivalen.
cases.steps: Uji env selector unset/kosong/default; override eksplisit tiap ekstensi; bandingkan parsed mapping.
cases.expected: Default /etc/odoo/amr_sentry.yaml; AMR_SENTRY_CONFIG hanya lokasi; namespace SDK dan policy terpisah; format ekuivalen sama.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Missing/unreadable/malformed/schema
cases.preconditions: Proses baru per subcase, init spy dan secret marker.
cases.steps: Uji file missing/unreadable, YAML/JSON rusak, null/list root, sentry/policy bukan mapping, ekstensi tak didukung; override invalid dengan default valid.
cases.expected: 0 init/capture; warning generik tanpa config/DSN/error text; bisnis usable; override tidak fallback.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Policy defaults dan tipe
cases.preconditions: File valid, safe-profile lengkap.
cases.steps: Omit enabled/mode; uji enabled string/int, mode uppercase/unknown, policy unknown key.
cases.expected: Omitted => false/none; tipe/enum/key invalid => disabled sebelum init; tidak coercion.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Profile key hilang — tiap key
cases.preconditions: Active valid control dan daftar profile PRD.
cases.steps: Hapus tepat satu dari setiap safety key, dsn tetap valid; proses baru setiap subcase.
cases.expected: Semua varian 0 SDK init/events, warning aman; control diterima. Tidak default/repair/inject field hilang.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Unsafe/wrong type/extra option
cases.preconditions: Active valid control.
cases.steps: Setiap bool ubah true/null/string/0; integrations nonempty; max_breadcrumbs 1/false/string; body medium; unknown SDK option; data_collection/with_locals/request_bodies; nonmapping sentry.
cases.expected: Setiap nilai tak sesuai exact schema ditolak sebelum init; bool tidak diterima sebagai integer; no retries dengan opsi dikurangi.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: File-only kwargs dan kontaminasi env
cases.preconditions: Real SDK test-boundary init recorder; file dan env synthetic berbeda.
cases.steps: Aktifkan file aman dengan metadata file eksplisit; seed SENTRY_DSN/ENVIRONMENT/RELEASE/DEBUG; bandingkan input init dan effective options; ulang tanpa dsn file.
cases.expected: Privacy kwargs persis file, tanpa hidden defaults adapter; env tak enable/mengganti file; metadata env/host yang tak disetujui => HOLD D-GLOBAL, tidak silently whitelist.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Matriks mode
cases.preconditions: Satu proses per mode, real SDK MemoryTransport.
cases.steps: Sukses/gagal pada all/error/selected/none; selected record persisted opt-in on/off; ulang enabled=false serta dsn absent/empty.
cases.expected: Delta all=[1,1], error=[0,1], selected on=[1,1], off=[0,0], none=[0,0]; disabled/DSN kosong 0 init/events; sukses fixed info message.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Identitas selected dan negative fallback
cases.preconditions: Real persisted client A opted-in/B opted-out; effective ORM override.
cases.steps: Call hook eksplisit A di empty self; bound singleton A; explicit B pada bound A; empty/absent client + kw sentry_opt_in=true; non-singleton.
cases.expected: A eligible once, explicit B menang dan nol; absent/empty/non-singleton tak dipilih nol; kwargs tidak fallback; tidak restore tags/extra/customer name.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Outside-hook logging
cases.preconditions: Real SDK + safe file; all/error/selected eligible, isolated process.
cases.steps: Log ordinary error sebelum/sesudah hook; simpan effective integration list dan seluruh envelope item types.
cases.expected: Outside delta 0; hook delta sesuai mode; integrations []; tidak event/log/trace/metric/session/client-report tambahan.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Outside-hook unhandled exception
cases.preconditions: Child process terkendali, real SDK transport lokal yang bisa diekspor saat exit.
cases.steps: Init safe file, raise synthetic unhandled exception di luar hook; periksa child exit dan captured envelopes.
cases.expected: Unhandled business child exit tetap expected nonzero, telemetry delta 0; exit nonzero bukan kegagalan harness; diulang active modes.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Privacy channel terpisah — bukan exception text
cases.preconditions: Real SDK, safe file, safe constant exception text; marker unik per channel.
cases.steps: Seed locals, header, request/response body, credential, kwargs, user/contexts/tags/extra/breadcrumbs/attachments; inspeksi serialized envelopes/transport dan telemetry diagnostics; success/error/selected on/off.
cases.expected: Nol marker private, frame vars/source lines dan unwanted attachments; no legacy metadata; off/absent client nol. Lokasi tiap marker dicatat; jangan infer forwarding dari pencarian global.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Exception-message/path residual terpisah
cases.preconditions: Synthetic exception mengandung marker hanya pada text/path, bukan locals/private args.
cases.steps: Capture original exception dan chained exception melalui hook; cari marker text/path dalam serialized bytes; catat lokasi dan putusan Owner D-EX.
cases.expected: Tidak klaim zero arbitrary data. Bila marker lolos, strict privacy FAIL/HOLD; hanya keputusan eksplisit scoped residual atau revisi kontrak telemetry dapat menutup gate. Tidak custom scrubber/replace exception otomatis.
cases.gate: D-EX OPEN: Owner memilih kontrak exception; probe hanya setelah izin sandbox

cases.title: SDK global/current/isolation dan integrasi lain
cases.preconditions: Real SDK2, proses terpisah; marker scope dan another-client fixture.
cases.steps: Seed global/current/isolation metadata/processors; simulasi SDK lain initialized sebelum/sesudah bootstrap; capture hook; bandingkan routing/client/DSN dan scope.
cases.expected: Tidak bocor metadata atau salah client/DSN. Kontaminasi = FAIL/HOLD; fresh/new/isolation_scope bukan bukti cukup; proses non-eksklusif tidak diterima tanpa desain baru.
cases.gate: D-GLOBAL OPEN: exclusivity constraint/design review + otorisasi sandbox

cases.title: call return/exception dan SDK failures
cases.preconditions: Actual ServiceClient.call, synthetic request transport; baseline business oracle direkam.
cases.steps: Uji success response identity, HTTP error dan prepare/request error; injeksi import/init failure, capture_message failure, capture_exception failure, transport failure secara terpisah.
cases.expected: Return/re-raise identity dan raise_exception behavior sama baseline; SDK failure tidak escape; diagnostics aman; pre-assignment response defect dicatat terpisah, bukan silently fixed.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Persisted dispatch/log
cases.preconditions: Actual registry; create+commit synthetic service client/endpoint/credential dan log records.
cases.steps: Jalankan ServiceClientSend.dispatch_send success/error active_log on/off; log.send dan log.dispatch_send; baca state/response/client/log count via fresh cursor.
cases.expected: Business return/state/exception/log persistence sesuai source/baseline; hook tepat per outcome; capture/transport failure tak mengubah business persistence. model.new() saja tidak cukup.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Actions dan deduplikasi
cases.preconditions: Persisted action fixtures dengan handler/error handler/next action.
cases.steps: Jalankan request-failure, request-success+handler-failure, next-action-failure; ulang SDK failures.
cases.expected: Request failure tak ditangkap ulang action; request-success+handler-failure boleh dua outcome; handler/return/business error sama baseline; no auto logging event tambahan.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Bootstrap/restart/multi-registry
cases.preconditions: Dua DB disposable, worker/preload topology dicatat.
cases.steps: Import ulang dalam proses sama; edit salinan config lalu sebelum/sesudah restart; install optional hanya DB A, buka DB B; ulang worker/fork topology.
cases.expected: Sekali init per proses sesuai kontrak; config baru hanya setelah restart; tidak reporting DB B/tenant lain tanpa authority. Jika process-wide SDK tak bisa memenuhi => HOLD D-GLOBAL, bukan ubah jadi init per DB.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Exact interpreter/dependency full graph
cases.preconditions: Approved disposable digest/lock dan artifact provenance, bukan live environment.
cases.steps: Rekam Python patch, Odoo/OS/OpenSSL/PG, full pip freeze/list/check baseline+candidate dan import paths; review full constraints Odoo versus sandbox override.
cases.expected: Python tepat 3.7.3/Odoo13; pip check 0 dan graph/provenance lengkap; Requests adjustment test-only eksplisit; tidak no-deps/ignore-installed; bukan security approval.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Optional fresh install dan upgrade
cases.preconditions: Fresh DB plus separate upgrade fixture/checkpoint; real SDK/PyYAML declared prerequisites.
cases.steps: Fresh install amr_service_client,amr_sentry; upgrade seeded baseline fixture; readback module states/registry/models/opt-in; ulang safe policy smoke.
cases.expected: Fresh dan upgrade keduanya installed/usable; effective optional override dibuktikan capture, bukan hanya callable; missing declared dependency = BLOCKED prerequisite, bukan janji fallback import yaml.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Settings/UI/docs operator
cases.preconditions: Registry/UI sandbox; draft README/operator perubahan sesuai PRD.
cases.steps: Review root/addon README links dan complete examples; inspect global Settings removed; toggle per-client opt-in; seed old ir.config_parameter; render UI.
cases.expected: Old settings tidak efektif; opt-in ada dan berpengaruh selected; docs target3.7.3 dan test-only dependency caveat benar; browser waiver lama tak diwarisi; examples valid JSON/YAML.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Containment/no-egress
cases.preconditions: DB/network namespace internal-only tanpa published ports; MemoryTransport test-only override.
cases.steps: Sebelum init aktifkan network isolation, DNS/socket/HTTP monitoring/guards (DB:5432 only); jalankan suite, inspect denied and successful calls plus all envelope types.
cases.expected: 0 non-DB DNS/network attempt/success dari tested paths; zero-egress dibuktikan berlapis, bukan .invalid DSN; hook envelope tetap local. Test transport injection satu-satunya approved kwargs test exception dan dicatat.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Evidence/approval binding
cases.preconditions: Accepted exact-hash docs dan authorized remediation SHA baru bila ada.
cases.steps: Validasi sha candidate/base/source blobs, config hash, images/lock/oracles; catat status seluruh subcase, command argv/exit dan sanitized evidence manifest.
cases.expected: Historical logs hanya provenance; tak ada UAT PASS diturunkan dari exit0/L1; changed SHA/config wajib rebind; seluruh subcase dihitung dan setiap AC punya oracle.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox

cases.title: Rollback rehearsal dan cleanup exact IDs
cases.preconditions: Run-owned resource inventory sebelum create; baseline immutable.
cases.steps: Rehearse disabled/none+restart dan restore fixture; drop/readback exact DBs sebelum PG hilang; remove run-owned containers/networks/images/volumes dan inspect tiap ID termasuk anonymous Odoo volumes.
cases.expected: Core tetap usable, optional disabled; exact DB absence dan per-ID volume absence tercatat; baseline preserved; tidak broad prune. Resource tanpa ID = cleanup gap/HOLD, bukan full cleanup PASS.
cases.gate: Owner exact-hash approval + otorisasi terpisah runtime sandbox
